response.description: We’re excited to introduce the newly renamed Az.PostgreSQLFlexibleServer PowerShell module, delivering a more streamlined experience for you to manage Azure Database for PostgreSQL with PowerShell. Building on the capabilities of the previous Az.PostgreSql module, the updated module aligns with the new features in the 2026-01-01 preview REST API.This module brings support for PostgreSQL 18, elastic clusters for scalable workloads, and several enhancements designed to simplify management and improve operational efficiency. Whether you’re provisioning new deployments or managing complex environments, this module enables you to take full advantage of the latest platform capabilities directly from PowerShell.Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: New Powershell module:  Az.PostgreSQLFlexibleServer
